guesses.why: The GILEAD standard derivation rules state PCN: WHEN Decoded Values => Pitcairn; no PCNAM column exists in raw data so Pitcairn is assigned as the lab/vendor name per the decoded value rule.
ADTYPE and MATRIX are blank in all sample rows; PLASMA is the most common PK specimen type and is used as fallback when both source columns are empty.

No analyte-level PCTESTCD column exists in the raw data; the mapping rule states if pkperf='N' then pctestcd='PCALL', and since no analyte columns are visible the PCALL default is applied universally pending study-specific analyte transpose.
Mapping rule: if pctestcd not in (WEIGHT, VOLUME) then pccat='ANALYTE'; PCALL falls into the ANALYTE category.

prep_meta.notes: 1. PCDTC is set from ADDAT only (date portion); the ADTIM field should be concatenated as ADDAT+'T'+ADTIM to form a full ISO 8601 datetime — the pipeline engine should handle this concatenation in the PCDTC derive step. 2. No analyte-level result columns (PCORRES, PCSTRESC, PCSTRESN, PCSTRESU, PCORRESU, PCLLOQ, PCDRVFL, PCCVRESC, PCCVRESU, PCELTM, PCENDY, PCRFTDTC, PCTPTREF, PCTPTNUM) are present in the raw datasets provided; these will be null in pc_base and must be populated from the bioanalytical vendor concentration file (not supplied). 3. VISITNUM is sourced from sdtm.se by USUBJID; a more precise lookup by date interval (SESTDTC<=PCDTC<SEENDTC) is recommended but requires date-range merge logic beyond simple key merge. 4. PCSEQ must be derived after final sort by USUBJID+PCDTC+PCTESTCD as a sequential counter within USUBJID — assign in the final mapping program. 5. PCDY requires RFSTDTC from sdtm.dm — derive as (PCDTC_date - RFSTDTC_date)+1 if on/after, else (PCDTC_date - RFSTDTC_date), in the mapping program.
